utfall: grein 4: frafallsrisiko i høyere utdanning; ingen forskjell mellom minoritets- og majoritetsstudenter i Norge (ingen tall i sammendraget)
sammenligning: minoritet mot majoritet, Norge mot USA
sitat: We found that while the US higher education system tends to exacerbate initial socioeconomic inequalities between minority and majority students, there is no difference in the dropout risk among minority and majority students in Norway.
